name: Value Added Tax return
legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2001, s. 1 — the tax period is one month ending on the last day of each month of the calendar year; s. 27(1) — a vendor files a return for each tax period with the Commissioner General; s. 27(2) — the return is in the form the Commissioner prescribes. The boxes below follow the structure of s. 20(1) (output tax A less input tax B); the numbering is this pack's own, because the form RSL prescribes was not published in a text this pack could read — the README says so.

deadline.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2001, s. 27(1) — within twenty days after the end of the period; s. 37(1)(a) — the tax is due and payable on the date the return is to be filed. s. 27(4) lets the Commissioner extend the filing, but not the payment (s. 27(5)).

boxes.name: Supplies at the standard rate of 15 %, VAT-exclusive
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2001, s. 20(1), item A — the tax payable on the taxable supplies made in the period; the base is the taxable value of the supplies at the rate of 15 % (s. 12, s. 14).

boxes.name: Supplies of electricity at 10 %, VAT-exclusive
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Regulations, 2003, reg. 6(1)(b), as amended by Legal Notice No. 30 of 2021 — the taxable value of supplies of electricity.

boxes.name: Zero-rated supplies, other than exports
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2001, s. 19(3) — supplies at the zero rate the regulations prescribe, such as basic commodities.

boxes.name: Exports, zero-rated
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2001, s. 19(2) — exports of goods or services by a vendor at the rate of zero.

boxes.name: Exempt supplies
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2001, s. 6(2) — exempt supplies carry no tax and no input credit.

boxes.name: Output tax at 15 %
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2001, s. 20(1), item A — the value added tax payable on the taxable supplies of box 1.

boxes.name: Output tax on electricity at 10 %
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2001, s. 20(1), item A — the tax payable on the supplies of box 2.

boxes.name: Tax on imported services, self-assessed
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2001, s. 7(1)(b) and s. 11(1)(b) — the tax on an import of services is paid by the importer.

boxes.name: Total output tax
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2001, s. 20(1) — item A, the sum of boxes 6, 7 and 8.

boxes.name: Input tax on local purchases
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2001, s. 20(1), item B, and s. 23(1)(a) — input tax allowed as a credit on taxable supplies to the vendor.

boxes.name: Input tax on imported goods
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2001, s. 23(1)(a) and s. 24(4)(b) — input tax on a taxable import, evidenced by a bill of entry or other customs document.

boxes.name: Total input tax
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2001, s. 20(1) — item B, the sum of boxes 10 and 11.

boxes.name: Value added tax payable or (refundable)
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2001, s. 20(1) — the tax payable for a period is A − B; a negative figure is an excess credit. This pack writes the signed subtraction.
